name: Lacustrine-Tarn
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are a binary sunset, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Debris from the starship crash site (warship) rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
